goal: Implement application services (CQRS commands) and infrastructure adapters: Register, Authenticate, Refresh, Logout command handlers. JWT token issuer. PostgreSQL repositories for users and sessions. Domain event emission (UserRegistered).

tasks.name: JWT token issuer + PostgreSQL repositories
tasks.action: Implement the infrastructure adapters: JWT issuer (golang-jwt HS256, signs access tokens with user claims), PostgreSQL user repository, and PostgreSQL session repository. All implement domain interfaces.
microSteps: Implement jwt_issuer.go: TokenIssuer struct with secret []byte and accessTTL duration. IssueAccessToken(userID, email) (string, error) — creates JWT with sub, email, iat, exp claims using HS256. ValidateAccessToken(tokenStr) (*Claims, error) — parses and validates, returns Claims{UserID, Email}.
Write jwt_issuer_test.go: test sign + verify round-trip, expired token rejection, tampered token rejection
Implement postgres_user_repo.go: implements UserRepository — Create (INSERT RETURNING), GetByID (SELECT by id), GetByEmail (SELECT by email), Update (UPDATE SET)

Implement postgres_session_repo.go: implements SessionRepository — Create (INSERT), GetByTokenHash (SELECT WHERE NOT revoked AND expires_at > now()), RevokeByID (UPDATE SET revoked=true), RevokeAllForUser (UPDATE SET revoked=true WHERE user_id)

tasks.name: Command handlers (Register, Authenticate, Refresh, Logout)
tasks.action: Implement the CQRS command handlers in internal/identity/app/command/. Each handler orchestrates domain objects and repositories. Register emits UserRegistered domain event via the event bus.
microSteps: Implement events.go in domain/user: UserRegistered event struct (UserID, Email, Timestamp) implementing event.Event interface

Implement register.go: RegisterHandler with UserRepository, EventPublisher deps. Handle(ctx, RegisterCmd{Email, Password, DisplayName}) → validate password, check email uniqueness, hash password, create User, emit UserRegistered
Write register_test.go: test successful registration, duplicate email conflict, invalid password rejection. Use mock repos (interfaces).

Implement authenticate.go: AuthenticateHandler with UserRepository, SessionRepository, TokenIssuer. Handle(ctx, AuthCmd{Email, Password}) → find user by email, verify password, generate refresh token, issue access token, return token pair
Write authenticate_test.go: test successful login, wrong password, user not found

Implement refresh.go: RefreshHandler with SessionRepository, UserRepository, TokenIssuer. Handle(ctx, RefreshCmd{RawToken}) → hash token, find session, check expiry, revoke old, create new refresh token, issue new access token (token rotation)
Implement logout.go: LogoutHandler with SessionRepository. Handle(ctx, LogoutCmd{RawToken}) → hash token, revoke session

tasks.name: Service wiring
tasks.action: Create the Identity service factory that wires all dependencies together. Takes pgx pool, event publisher, and config — returns a fully assembled application with all command handlers.
microSteps: Implement wire.go: Application struct holding all command handlers. NewApplication(pool *pgxpool.Pool, publisher event.Publisher, jwtSecret string, accessTTL, refreshTTL time.Duration) *Application — constructs repos, token issuer, and handlers

tdd.reason: Pure wiring code. Verified by successful compilation.

commitMessage: feat(identity): application layer — command handlers, JWT issuer, PostgreSQL repos, UserRegistered event
